# dreyv — Developers (scoped llms.txt)

> Scoped agent context for building against dreyv. See `/llms-full.txt` for full product context.

## Start here
- Developer portal: https://dreyv.com/developers
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://dreyv.com/openapi.json
- ai-plugin manifest: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- ACP descriptor: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/acp.json
- UCP profile: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ucp
- API catalog: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- x402 payment capability: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/x402

## SDKs
- TypeScript SDK: `@dreyv/sdk` (in monorepo `packages/sdk`)
- CLI: `@dreyv/cli` (in monorepo `packages/cli`)

## Quickstart (curl)
```bash
# Public price
curl https://dreyv.com/api/price?token=SOL

# Authenticated plan
curl -X POST https://dreyv.com/api/planner \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DREYV_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"intent":"rebalance 25% USDC into mSOL over 5 days"}'
```

## Sandbox
- Devnet sandbox available at `/developers#sandbox`.
- All swap/sign endpoints return unsigned transactions; the client signs.
